project.name: sc035hgs-esp32-p4x-camera-adapter-mod
project.design_state: Existing Espressif-derived 4-layer 1.6 mm board (32 x 24 mm) to be updated from the SC035HGS schematic; J2 moves to the top edge, J3 goes on a board edge, and the outline may grow (user decision 2026-10-01).

order_form.thickness_tolerance: JLCPCB standard tolerance (currently published as +/-10% for thickness >=1.0 mm); confirm at quote

impedance_control.status: MIPI requires 100 ohm differential +/-10%; use the selected stackup in JLCPCB's calculator and confirm precision testing availability. Public guidance says standard impedance testing is +/-20%, which does not meet this target.

panelization.notes: Decide after Edge.Cuts dimensions are finalized. JLCPCB recommends considering panelization for boards <=50 x 50 mm; single-board ordering remains a valid prototype choice.

remarks: Use laminate code JLC04161H-7628 and confirm it is still offered for 4-layer, 1.6 mm boards when quoting.
Do not use the present KiCad Default diff-pair width/gap as the MIPI impedance geometry; calculate and record width/gap from the exact manufacturer stackup before routing.
Use ENIG as the recommended flat finish for the 0.5 mm-pitch camera FPC connector; verify the selected finish in the live order form.
The 1.6 mm thickness is a standard nominal prototype choice; verify mechanical fit/tolerance against the mating adapter/header before fabrication.

layers.name: F.Mask
layers.role: Top solder mask; actual cured thickness is CAM-controlled

layers.name: dielectric 1
layers.role: Top-to-L2 dielectric; Dk per JLCPCB capability table

layers.name: In1.Cu
layers.role: Continuous GND reference plane; no signal routing

layers.name: dielectric 2
layers.role: L2-to-L3 core; Dk is a generic FR-4 value, use JLC calculator for impedance dimensions

layers.name: In2.Cu
layers.role: Power distribution plane; only use for signals if a continuous reference plane is preserved

layers.name: dielectric 3
layers.role: L3-to-bottom dielectric; Dk per JLCPCB capability table

layers.name: B.Mask
layers.role: Bottom solder mask; actual cured thickness is CAM-controlled

pairs.reference_plane: Continuous In1.Cu GND plane where routed on F.Cu
Continuous In1.Cu GND plane where routed on F.Cu
Continuous In1.Cu GND plane where routed on F.Cu

calculation_record.configuration: 4 layers; 1.6 mm selection; 1 oz outer copper; 0.5 oz inner copper; differential pair non-coplanar; F.Cu/L1 signal over In1.Cu/L2 reference; 100 ohm target; 8.00 mil pair gap
recalculation_required_if: selected stackup, thickness, copper weight, signal layer, reference layer, soldermask treatment, or pair gap changes
MIPI route switches to coplanar geometry or a different layer

layer_guidance: L2/In1.Cu: continuous GND plane; keep signals and plane splits out from under MIPI traces.
L3/In2.Cu: power distribution; high-speed signal use only with a verified continuous reference plane.
Espressif's ESP32-P4 MIPI guidance also calls for pair-to-pair skew <=30 mil and intra-pair skew <=10 mil.

kicad_project_settings.status: Not applied yet: run apply_pcb_fabrication_profile on the active board at PCB start (dry run first). The current board still carries the Espressif netclasses (DP_CSI_A_* 0.1778/0.1778 mm), which do not match this stackup.

must_fill_before_quote: Final board outline dimensions after placement (32 x 24 mm or larger)
Order number marking and TG grade if the live quote form requires explicit choices
Current live availability and price for the selected stackup and ENIG finish
must_verify_before_fabrication: Recalculate the MIPI geometry if the final routing differs from the recorded F.Cu over continuous In1.Cu GND configuration
Confirm JLCPCB precision impedance testing can meet the ESP32-P4 +/-10% target (standard free test is documented as +/-20%)
Confirm connector/header mechanical fit, board outline tolerance, and thickness tolerance
Re-run KiCad DRC after the user completes layout; this profile does not imply DRC/fabrication readiness
